text:
nina: quick heads-up — i'm about to kick off a hybrid quant + canary curation run for q6b-int4 longctx samples. want to avoid holdout leakage and get labeling prioritized for ~3k edge prompts.
sam: ok — what’s the target split between synthetic anchors vs real seedbank?
nina: aiming 60% real seedbank, 30% synthetic anchors, 10% adversarial-aug. focus on longprompt / code-gen edgecases.
leo: labeler capacity? i can reserve 6 annotators for the week if we batch.
morgan: +1 for reserving. also we should lock the golden set snapshot before any relabels. otherwise regressions will be noisy.
ops-bot: run created: hybrid-curation-3351236789 (owner: nina). ETA: 48h. Status: queued.
nina: thanks. plan: 1) snapshot current golden -> tag g_snap_3351 2) create curated holdout (no overlap with g_snap_3351) 3) seed labeler queue with stratified batches 4) run smoke eval on q6b-int4 int4 kernels 
leo: for step 2, how strict is 'no overlap'? do we dedupe at prompt hash or at normalized-token-level?
sam: prefer token-level norm + fuzzyhash threshold 0.85 to catch paraphrase collisions. earlier collisions came from trivial punctuation diffs.
morgan: agreed. we should add a manual-review bucket for near-threshold matches. give labelers context: "possible duplicate — check paraphrase / intent".
nina: labeling instructions (short):
```
- Mark as DUP if same intent and answers equivalent.
- Mark as NEAR_DUP if intent same but outputs diverge semantically.
- Flag HALLU if model output invents facts.
- For code prompts, run snippet if possible; attach failing testcase.
```
sam: can we add a quick script to surface token-length distribution per batch? helps pick quant profiles.
leo: i'll drop this in ops channel: `python tools/batch_stats.py --run hybrid-curation-3351236789 --out s3://redwood-curation/tmp/stats.json`
ops-bot: batch_stats job submitted by leo.
morgan: golden snapshot checklist:
- store tokenizer version
- store model binary id + quant config used for eval
- freeze promptset hash
- export 1k sample manual review subset
nina: +1. also let's capture eval metrics to compare hosted vs dedicated kernels: latency, pt-loss, and hallucination rate per bucket.
sam: what’s the rollback policy if quant canary shows >3% hallucination regression on golden?
morgan: auto-fallback to int8-compatible model variant + revert routing for production traffic for the affected route. ops will trigger emergency revert.
leo: tagging people: @morgan please confirm rollback playbook in console and @sam can you add the canary eval DAG?
morgan: confirmed — playbook present. adding a breakpoint to stop rollout at 3% hallucination.
sam: i’ll add the DAG and set notification to #eng-oncall and #product.
nina: final ask — keep microgolden set out of the sampling pool for this run. we want fresh signals.
leo: noted. starting dedupe pass now. will post a short summary when done. :eyes: 
ops-bot: dedupe job finished (dedupe_rate=0.12). 3120 samples ready for labeling.
morgan: perfect. labeler queue link: https://labelling.redwood/team/queues/3351236789
leo: launching first batch (batch_id=3351236789-b1).
sam: monitoring evals; will report back scalar diffs in ~6h.
nina: thanks all — ping here for any blockers. :thumbsup:
